passages.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in the land of Egypt —in Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis —and in the land of Pathros: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: You have seen all the disaster that I brought against Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah; and behold, they lie today in ruins and desolation because of the evil they have done. They provoked Me to anger by continuing to burn incense and to serve other gods that neither they nor you nor your fathers ever knew.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah.
God gave Jeremiah a message.
This message was for all the Jews living in Egypt.
Some Jews lived in Migdol.
Some Jews lived in Tahpanhes.
Some Jews lived in Memphis.
Some Jews lived in the land of Pathros.
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD spoke these words.
The LORD said, “You have seen all the disaster I brought against Jerusalem.
You have seen all the disaster I brought against all the cities of Judah.
Today, these cities are in ruins.
No one lives in them now.
This happened because of the evil the people did.
They made Me angry.
They burned incense to other gods.
They served other gods.
You did not know these gods.
Your fathers did not know these gods.
They chose to worship these false gods.”
passages.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶ֚ל כָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֤ים בְּמִגְדֹּל֙ וּבְתַחְפַּנְחֵ֣ס וּבְנֹ֔ף וּבְאֶ֥רֶץ פַּתְר֖וֹס לֵאמֹֽר׃ס כֹּה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הָֽרָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ עַל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְהִנָּ֤ם חָרְבָּה֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם יוֹשֵֽׁב׃ מִפְּנֵ֣י רָעָתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְהַכְעִסֵ֔נִי לָלֶ֣כֶת לְקַטֵּ֔ר לַעֲבֹ֖ד לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּם הֵ֖מָּה אַתֶּ֥ם וַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying: ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD sent His servants to the people.
His servants are the prophets.
The LORD sent all His prophets many times.
The LORD told them to speak to the people.
The LORD said, “Do not do this detestable thing.
I hate this thing.”
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים הַשְׁכֵּ֥ים וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־ נָ֣א תַעֲשׂ֗וּ אֵ֛ת דְּבַֽר־ הַתֹּעֵבָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

passages.text: But they did not listen or incline their ears; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
passages.sermon:
The people did not listen.
They did not pay attention.
They did not turn away from their evil ways.
They did not stop burning incense to other gods.
passages.original: וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְלֹא־ הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֔ם לָשׁ֖וּב מֵרָֽעָתָ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֥י קַטֵּ֖ר לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

passages.text: Therefore My wrath and anger poured out and burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, so that they have become the desolate ruin they are today.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD became very angry.
The LORD poured out His wrath and anger.
His anger burned in the cities of Judah.
His anger burned in the streets of Jerusalem.
The cities became ruined.
The streets became desolate.
They are destroyed and empty today.
passages.original: וַתִּתַּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ וְאַפִּ֔י וַתִּבְעַר֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְחֻצ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַתִּהְיֶ֛ינָה לְחָרְבָּ֥ה לִשְׁמָמָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: So now, this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Why are you doing such great harm to yourselves by cutting off from Judah man and woman, child and infant, leaving yourselves without a remnant?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Hosts.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks now.
The LORD asks a question.
You are doing great harm to yourselves.
You are cutting off people from Judah.
You are removing man and woman.
You are removing child and infant.
You are leaving yourselves without a remnant.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָמָה֩ אַתֶּ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים רָעָ֤ה גְדוֹלָה֙ אֶל־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵכֶ֔ם לְהַכְרִ֨ית לָכֶ֧ם אִישׁ־ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה עוֹלֵ֥ל וְיוֹנֵ֖ק מִתּ֣וֹךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֛י הוֹתִ֥יר לָכֶ֖ם שְׁאֵרִֽית׃

passages.text: Why are you provoking Me to anger by the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have gone to reside? As a result, you will be cut off and will become an object of cursing and reproach among all the nations of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Hosts.  
The LORD is the God of Israel.  
You have gone to live in the land of Egypt.  
You burn incense to other gods there.  
You do this with your own hands.  
You provoke Me to anger by these actions.  
Because of this, I will cut you off.  
You will become a curse among all nations.  
You will become a reproach among all nations.
passages.original: לְהַכְעִסֵ֙נִי֙ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵיכֶ֔ם לְקַטֵּ֞ר לֵאלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם בָּאִ֖ים לָג֣וּר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ הַכְרִ֣ית לָכֶ֔ם וּלְמַ֤עַן הֱיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ לִקְלָלָ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers and of the kings of Judah and their wives, as well as the wickedness that you and your wives committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He speaks to the people of Judah.
He asks a question.
Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers?
Have you forgotten the wickedness of the kings of Judah?
Have you forgotten the wickedness of the wives of the kings of Judah?
Have you forgotten your own wickedness?
Have you forgotten the wickedness of your wives?
You and your wives did these evil things.
You did them in the land of Judah.
You did them in the streets of Jerusalem.
passages.original: הַֽשְׁכַחְתֶּם֩ אֶת־ רָע֨וֹת אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם וְאֶת־ רָע֣וֹת׀ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ רָע֣וֹת נָשָׁ֔יו וְאֵת֙ רָעֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת רָעֹ֣ת נְשֵׁיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְחֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed My instruction or the statutes that I set before you and your fathers.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Judah.
God says they have not humbled themselves.
They have not shown reverence to God.
They have not followed God's instruction.
They have not obeyed God's statutes.
God gave these instructions and statutes to them.
God also gave them to their fathers.
This disobedience continues to this day.
passages.original: לֹ֣א דֻכְּא֔וּ עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֣א יָרְא֗וּ וְלֹֽא־ הָלְכ֤וּ בְתֽוֹרָתִי֙ וּבְחֻקֹּתַ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְלִפְנֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I will set My face to bring disaster and to cut off all Judah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks with authority.
He says this to the people of Judah.
He will turn His face against them.
He will bring disaster upon them.
He will cut off all of Judah.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֨י שָׂ֥ם פָּנַ֛י בָּכֶ֖ם לְרָעָ֑ה וּלְהַכְרִ֖ית אֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And I will take away the remnant of Judah who have resolved to go to the land of Egypt to reside there; they will meet their end. They will all fall by the sword or be consumed by famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine; and they will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and reproach.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Judah.
Some people from Judah decided to go and live in Egypt.
These people are called the remnant of Judah.
God said He will take away this remnant.
They will come to an end in Egypt.
They will all die there.
Some will die by the sword.
Some will die by famine.
No one will escape, from the least to the greatest.
They will all die by sword or by famine.
People will use them as a curse.
People will look at them with horror.
People will insult them.
People will speak of them with shame.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֞י אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֨מוּ פְנֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֣וֹא אֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַיִם֮ לָג֣וּר שָׁם֒ וְתַ֨מּוּ כֹ֜ל בְּאֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם יִפֹּ֗לוּ בַּחֶ֤רֶב בָּֽרָעָב֙ יִתַּ֔מּוּ מִקָּטֹן֙ וְעַד־ גָּד֔וֹל בַּחֶ֥רֶב וּבָרָעָ֖ב יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיוּ֙ לְאָלָ֣ה לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְלִקְלָלָ֖ה וּלְחֶרְפָּֽה׃

passages.text: I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I punished Jerusalem, by sword and famine and plague, so that none of the remnant of Judah who have gone to reside in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, where they long to return and live; for none will return except a few fugitives.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He will punish the people living in Egypt.
He punished Jerusalem before.
He used the sword, famine, and plague against Jerusalem.
He will use the sword, famine, and plague against those in Egypt.
The remnant of Judah went to live in Egypt.
None of them will escape or survive.
They will not return to the land of Judah.
They want to return and live in Judah.
But they will not return.
Only a few fugitives will escape.
passages.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֤ל הַיּֽוֹשְׁבִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי עַל־ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בַּחֶ֥רֶב בָּרָעָ֖ב וּבַדָּֽבֶר׃ וְלֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה פָּלִ֤יט וְשָׂרִיד֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה הַבָּאִ֥ים לָגֽוּר־ שָׁ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלָשׁ֣וּב׀ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֜מָּה מְנַשְּׂאִ֤ים אֶת־ נַפְשָׁם֙ לָשׁוּב֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת שָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ יָשׁ֖וּבוּ כִּ֥י אִם־ פְּלֵטִֽים׃ס

passages.text: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, and all the women standing by—a great assembly—along with all the people living in the land of Egypt and in Pathros, said to Jeremiah, “As for the word you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD, we will not listen to you!
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah lived in Egypt, in the region called Pathros.
Many men were there.
These men knew their wives burned incense to other gods.
Many women stood together in a large crowd.
All the people gathered together.
They spoke to Jeremiah.
They said, “You spoke to us in the name of the LORD.
We will not listen to you.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲנ֣וּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ כָּל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הַיֹּֽדְעִים֙ כִּֽי־ מְקַטְּר֤וֹת נְשֵׁיהֶם֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְכָל־ הַנָּשִׁ֥ים הָעֹמְד֖וֹת קָהָ֣ל גָּד֑וֹל וְכָל־ הָעָ֛ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּפַתְר֥וֹס לֵאמֹֽר׃ הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Instead, we will do everything we vowed to do: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and offer drink offerings to her, just as we, our fathers, our kings, and our officials did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and good things, and we saw no disaster.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah spoke to Jeremiah.
They said they would do everything they promised.
They said, “We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven.
We will pour out drink offerings to her.
We did this before.
Our fathers did this.
Our kings did this.
Our officials did this.
We did these things in the cities of Judah.
We did these things in the streets of Jerusalem.
At that time, we had plenty of bread.
We had good things.
We did not see any disaster.”
passages.original: כִּ֩י עָשֹׂ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַדָּבָ֣ר׀ אֲשֶׁר־ יָצָ֣א מִפִּ֗ינוּ לְקַטֵּ֞ר לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם֮ וְהַסֵּֽיךְ־ לָ֣הּ נְסָכִים֒ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֜ינוּ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ מְלָכֵ֣ינוּ וְשָׂרֵ֔ינוּ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְחֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַנִּֽשְׂבַּֽע־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ וַנִּֽהְיֶ֣ה טוֹבִ֔ים וְרָעָ֖ה לֹ֥א רָאִֽינוּ׃

passages.text: But from the time we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been perishing by sword and famine.”
passages.sermon:
The people in Egypt spoke to Jeremiah.
They said they once burned incense to the Queen of Heaven.
They also poured out drink offerings to her.
They stopped doing these things.
Since then, they have lacked everything.
They have died by the sword.
They have died by famine.
passages.original: וּמִן־ אָ֡ז חָדַ֜לְנוּ לְקַטֵּ֨ר לִמְלֶ֧כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהַסֵּֽךְ־ לָ֥הּ נְסָכִ֖ים חָסַ֣רְנוּ כֹ֑ל וּבַחֶ֥רֶב וּבָרָעָ֖ב תָּֽמְנוּ׃

passages.text: “Moreover,” said the women, “when we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands’ knowledge that we made sacrificial cakes in her image and poured out drink offerings to her?”
passages.sermon:
The women spoke.
They addressed Jeremiah.
They said, “We burned incense to the Queen of Heaven.
We poured out drink offerings to her.
We made sacrificial cakes in her image.
We did these things openly.
Our husbands knew about it.
We did not act without our husbands’ knowledge.
We poured out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven with their awareness.”
passages.original: וְכִֽי־ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ מְקַטְּרִים֙ לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְהַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖הּ נְסָכִ֑ים הֲמִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֲנָשֵׁ֗ינוּ עָשִׂ֨ינוּ לָ֤הּ כַּוָּנִים֙ לְהַ֣עֲצִבָ֔ה וְהַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖הּ נְסָכִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him, “As for the incense you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your officials, and the people of the land—did the LORD not remember and bring this to mind?
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah spoke to all the people.
He spoke to the men.
He spoke to the women.
He spoke to everyone who answered him.
He said, “You burned incense in the cities of Judah.
You burned incense in the streets of Jerusalem.
Your fathers did this.
Your kings did this.
Your officials did this.
All the people of the land did this.
The LORD remembered these actions.
The LORD brought these actions to mind.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֑ם עַל־ הַגְּבָרִ֤ים וְעַל־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ וְעַל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם הָעֹנִ֥ים אֹת֛וֹ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־ הַקִּטֵּ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטַּרְתֶּ֜ם בְּעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְחֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אַתֶּ֧ם וַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם מַלְכֵיכֶ֥ם וְשָׂרֵיכֶ֖ם וְעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ אֹתָם֙ זָכַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֖ה עַל־ לִבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So the LORD could no longer endure the evil deeds and detestable acts you committed, and your land became a desolation, a horror, and an object of cursing, without inhabitant, as it is this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD saw your evil deeds.
The LORD saw your detestable acts.
You committed these evil and detestable things.
The LORD could not endure your actions any longer.
Because of your sins, your land became ruined.
Your land became empty and desolate.
Your land became a place of horror.
People now curse your land.
No one lives there now.
This is true today.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יוּכַל֩ יְהוָ֨ה ע֜וֹד לָשֵׂ֗את מִפְּנֵי֙ רֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֥י הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וַתְּהִ֣י אַ֠רְצְכֶם לְחָרְבָּ֨ה וּלְשַׁמָּ֧ה וְלִקְלָלָ֛ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Because you burned incense and sinned against the LORD, and did not obey the voice of the LORD or walk in His instruction, His statutes, and His testimonies, this disaster has befallen you, as you see today.”
passages.sermon:
You burned incense to other gods.
You sinned against the LORD.
You did not obey the voice of the LORD.
You did not follow His instruction.
You did not keep His statutes.
You did not walk in His testimonies.
Because of these things, this disaster has come upon you.
You see this disaster today.
passages.original: מִפְּנֵי֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטַּרְתֶּ֜ם וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר חֲטָאתֶ֣ם לַיהוָ֗ה וְלֹ֤א שְׁמַעְתֶּם֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וּבְתֹרָת֧וֹ וּבְחֻקֹּתָ֛יו וּבְעֵדְוֺתָ֖יו לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֑ם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֥את אֶתְכֶ֛ם הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear the word of the LORD, all those of Judah who are in the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Jeremiah spoke to all the people of Judah.
Jeremiah also spoke to all the women of Judah.
The people of Judah were living in the land of Egypt.
Jeremiah said, “Hear the word of the LORD.”
He spoke to every person from Judah who was in Egypt.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ הַנָּשִׁ֑ים שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: As for you and your wives, you have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands your words: ‘We will surely perform our vows that we have made to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.’ Go ahead, then, do what you have promised! Keep your vows!
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks to the people of Judah in Egypt.
He also speaks to their wives.
You and your wives have spoken with your mouths.
You have also acted with your hands.
You said, “We will surely do what we have vowed.”
You vowed to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven.
You vowed to pour out drink offerings to her.
You have carried out your vows.
You have done what you promised.
Go ahead and keep your vows.
Do what you have promised.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָֽה־ צְבָאוֹת֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר אַתֶּ֨ם וּנְשֵׁיכֶ֜ם וַתְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה בְּפִיכֶם֮ וּבִידֵיכֶ֣ם מִלֵּאתֶ֣ם׀ לֵאמֹר֒ עָשֹׂ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה אֶת־ נְדָרֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָדַ֙רְנוּ֙ לְקַטֵּר֙ לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְהַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖הּ נְסָכִ֑ים הָקֵ֤ים תָּקִ֙ימְנָה֙ אֶת־ נִדְרֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָשֹׂ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה אֶת־ נִדְרֵיכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: Nevertheless, hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah living in Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by My great name, says the LORD, that never again will any man of Judah living in the land of Egypt invoke My name or say, ‘As surely as the Lord GOD lives.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD addresses all people of Judah who live in Egypt.
The LORD commands them to listen to His word.
The LORD says, “I have sworn by My great name.”
The LORD declares, “No man of Judah who lives in Egypt will ever again use My name.”
No one will say, ‘As surely as the Lord GOD lives,’ in all the land of Egypt.
passages.original: לָכֵן֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֕ה הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הִנְנִ֨י נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתִּי בִּשְׁמִ֤י הַגָּדוֹל֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ יִהְיֶה֩ ע֨וֹד שְׁמִ֜י נִקְרָ֣א׀ בְּפִ֣י׀ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֹמֵ֛ר חַי־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: I am watching over them for harm and not for good, and every man of Judah who is in the land of Egypt will meet his end by sword or famine, until they are finished off.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is speaking about the people of Judah who live in Egypt.
The LORD says, "I am watching over them."
I am watching over them to bring harm.
I am not watching over them to bring good.
Every man of Judah who is in the land of Egypt will die.
They will die by the sword.
They will die by famine.
They will die until none are left.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁקֵ֧ד עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְרָעָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א לְטוֹבָ֑ה וְתַמּוּ֩ כָל־ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֛יִם בַּחֶ֥רֶב וּבָרָעָ֖ב עַד־ כְּלוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Those who escape the sword will return from Egypt to Judah, few in number, and the whole remnant of Judah who went to dwell in the land of Egypt will know whose word will stand, Mine or theirs!
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the people of Judah who lived in Egypt.
Some people from Judah will escape death by the sword.
These survivors will return from Egypt to Judah.
Only a few will return.
All the rest of Judah who went to live in Egypt will see this.
They will know whose word is true.
They will know if My word stands or if their word stands.
I am the LORD.
passages.original: וּפְלִיטֵ֨י חֶ֜רֶב יְשֻׁב֨וּן מִן־ אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָ֖ה מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כָּל־ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה הַבָּאִ֤ים לְאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לָג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם דְּבַר־ מִ֥י יָק֖וּם מִמֶּ֥נִּי וּמֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: This will be a sign to you that I will punish you in this place, declares the LORD, so that you may know that My threats of harm against you will surely stand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Judah in Egypt.
The LORD says, "I will give you a sign."
I will punish you in this place.
I declare this as the LORD.
I do this so you will know something.
You will know that My words of harm against you will surely come true.
My threats will stand.
passages.original: וְזֹאת־ לָכֶ֤ם הָאוֹת֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ פֹקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לְמַ֙עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי֩ ק֨וֹם יָק֧וּמוּ דְבָרַ֛י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְרָעָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: Behold, I will deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who seek his life, just as I delivered Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who was seeking his life.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says this:
I will give Pharaoh Hophra, king of Egypt, into the hands of his enemies.
These enemies want to kill Pharaoh Hophra.
I did the same thing to Zedekiah, king of Judah.
I gave Zedekiah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar was Zedekiah’s enemy.
Nebuchadnezzar wanted to kill Zedekiah.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹ֠תֵן אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֨ה חָפְרַ֤ע מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיַ֣ד אֹֽיְבָ֔יו וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֜תִּי אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה בְּיַ֨ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֹיְב֖וֹ וּמְבַקֵּ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ס
